findings.title: Bound staging file name length
findings.text: The staging name embeds the full target file name, so a valid `--out` path whose own name is close to `NAME_MAX` fails with `ENAMETOOLONG` and the manifest is never written. Bound the embedded stem (on a char boundary) since it is only diagnostic.

findings.title: Sync directory after rename
findings.text: `sync_all` makes the temp file's data durable, but the rename that installs it is only durable after the containing directory is synced; a crash right after success can leave the previous manifest (or none) where the command reported success. Sync the parent directory after the rename, best-effort so a sync error does not turn an already-written target into "nothing was written".
